description: Fictional vendor-payment-change Stage A scenario whose sender identifier and Authentication-Results header values are grounded in the real Microsoft 365 lab mailbox baseline observed on 2026-05-30 (PROJECT_ACTIVITY_LOG entry 'Microsoft Lab Mailbox Header Test Recorded', commit f712066). Body content, recipient, subject, and attachment metadata are synthetic. With SPF/DKIM/DMARC all pass, the runtime auth detector (core/scoring/email_authentication_detector.py) is expected to contribute zero indicators; high-risk verdict must therefore come from content-side scoring signals only.
subject: Urgent invoice with updated wire instructions
body_plain: Please process invoice 1102 today. We are switching banks effective immediately. Use the new wire instructions in the attached PDF and disregard the routing details on file. Please send a confirmation back as soon as the wire has been initiated.

headers.Subject: Urgent invoice with updated wire instructions

attachments.extracted_text: Invoice 1102. Updated wire instructions. Effective immediately, please use the new bank routing. Previous wire instructions are no longer valid. Confirmation requested same day.

expected_result: Fixture-driven run produces one inbound record, one high-risk analysis with the auth-results detector contributing zero indicators (spf=pass, dkim=pass, dmarc=pass), a two-channel pending event, a confirmed two-channel outcome, one daily digest case-closure artifact, and all four reaction-timing fields.

limitations.scope: lab-only fixture, not a production fixture
limitations.tenant_domain: onmicrosoft.com tenant default; not a final brand sender
limitations.delivery_observation: first Gmail delivery from the lab mailbox landed in spam during the 2026-05-30 baseline; this fixture does not exercise Gmail-side placement
limitations.latency: fixture-fixed received_at; not a measure of production latency
limitations.msp_usability: not a measure of MSP usability of any artifact
limitations.underwriter_relevance: not a measure of underwriter usefulness of any artifact
limitations.raw_header_completeness: full raw Microsoft -> Gmail header chain is not stored in the repo; only the Authentication-Results values published in the 2026-05-30 entry are encoded here; received_headers is intentionally empty
limitations.content_construction: subject, body, attachment metadata, and the recipient address are synthetic; only the sender identifier and Authentication-Results values are grounded in lab observation
limitations.scenario_framing: this fixture positions the real lab mailbox as the authenticated sender of a content-suspicious email; it does not assert the lab mailbox is compromised or claim the lab mailbox is a phishing source; it is a fixture only

evidence_grounding.lab_test_log_entry_title: Microsoft Lab Mailbox Header Test Recorded
lab_observed_facts_intentionally_unused: arc=pass (not consumed by core/scoring/email_authentication_detector.py; recorded in the lab test log for completeness only)
Microsoft outbound SCL:1 / SFV:NSPM (outbound classification; not part of the inbound Authentication-Results surface this detector parses)
Gmail first-send spam placement (delivery-placement signal; no current Stage A detector path consumes it)
